title: SEC sues Binance, then Coinbase (5-6 Jun 2023)
description: The SEC filed 13 charges against Binance and Changpeng Zhao on 5 June 2023 and sued Coinbase the next day. BTC fell about 5% on the Binance news.

headlines.title: SEC Files 13 Charges Against Binance Entities and Founder Changpeng Zhao
headlines.tsNote: Press release 2023-101 dated 5 Jun 2023; minute not verified (BTC's drop starts in the 15:00 UTC hour).

headlines.title: SEC Charges Coinbase for Operating as an Unregistered Securities Exchange, Broker, and Clearing Agency
headlines.tsNote: Press release 2023-102 dated 6 Jun 2023; minute not verified.

sources: Prices: Binance public klines BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, 15m (data-api.binance.vision)
